title: Lesson injection signal-to-noise: relevance gating and dedup
description:
Lessons are valuable but the current injection is noisy. Investigate how to raise signal-to-noise without losing the surfacing that makes lessons useful.

## Concrete observations (swe_dashboard session, adding an ayanamsha)

1. **Repetition per edit.** The PreToolUse:Edit hook injected the SAME lesson block on every Edit to a given file, and it appeared TWICE per call (duplicated in the hook output). Across ~10 edits in one session that lesson text was re-sent ~20 times. It re-enters model context each turn on top of that. Pure repeated overhead.

2. **Relevance mismatch.** The lesson repeatedly surfaced on ayanamsa_catalog.dart / calc_context.dart was about "migrating a tab's *ResultProvider from List<T>/T? to CalcOutcome<T>" — anchored to those files but irrelevant to the change being made (adding a catalog entry + resolution). It's anchored by file, so it fires for ANY edit to that file regardless of what the edit does.

3. **Unverified lessons carry equal weight.** The noisy one was tagged [unverified] with confidence 0, yet was injected as prominently as a high-confidence lesson would be.

## Questions to design around
- Should lesson injection dedup within a session (surface a given lesson id at most once, or once per file), rather than re-firing on every Edit? The hook double-emit is a straightforward bug to fix regardless.
- Can relevance gate on more than the file anchor — e.g. the symbols/regions the edit actually touches, or a semantic match against the diff — so a file-anchored lesson only fires when the edit is near its subject?
- Should [unverified]/low-confidence lessons be suppressed from proactive injection (still available via explicit sutra_lessons query), or shown more quietly?
- Token-cost framing: each injection rides every subsequent turn's context. Cheap-looking per-fire, expensive cumulatively.

## Not in scope
The lesson STORE and explicit sutra_lessons(query=) retrieval work fine — this is specifically about the proactive PreToolUse injection channel's noise.
